frame: dock-face frame: origin on the face at deck level, +Y up, +Z out of the island, X across. Rest pose in the glb = stowed (deploy 0). Per node: keys [[deploy, {pos, rot (quaternion x,y,z,w), scl}]] local to its parent, piecewise-linear (lerp pos/scl, slerp rot). Colliders: boxes in their node's local frame. nose_y: the nose's deck top (two islands' noses meet at the same height). clear: room the layout must keep free (inland: m behind the face along the bridge; along: [x0, x1] beside it on the face, out: m out from the face while stowed; below: m under the deck behind the face).
